Entries.Original: Good, everyone's all here.
Today's practice will cover Operation Pleiades, Phases Three through Five.
This training will simulate the consecutive combat situations through these phases.
After Phase Three, there will be a variety of tasks such as long-range support, urban warfare, and convoy escorts.
With more tasks and responsibilities aside from regular combat, your squad's abilities and judgment will be put to the test.
You may be pushed into making rash decisions due to the pressure.
However, do your best to act calmly and carefully at all times.
That being said, you all exhibited great results in yesterday's session. Take confidence in all that you've learned from training so far, and keep moving forward.
Ooh, she's really praising us this time! Are we getting a special reward for our hard work?
No. You should appreciate the fact that you get to eat delicious things every day.
That's true. We get three delicious meals a day. I think that's a pretty special reward in this time.
Yeah. The meat's delicious, so I guess I can't complain.
The stuff besides the meat is just as good too, you carnivore.
Now initializing training module. Remember what we taught you.
Squad 30-G has now arrived at the starting point on the former Route 246, please commence Phase Three.
Got it.
Roger!
Point Gamma
Campaign Route
Woah, look at that! We can see everyone fighting from here.
The other squads are starting to advance from the south.
Great. Let's drive the enemies west in a pincer attack.
Sounds good. Let's show 'em what we're made of!
You said it!
